subject: Quick check: Private hosting / Dedicated path and timing
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Tan <olivia.tan@auroraanalytics.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@auroraanalytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Sep 2026 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + suggested next steps (private hosting options)

Hi Olivia / Samir —

Thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and my proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

• Need: low-latency inference for your customer-facing agent (1–2 token/step latencies) and strict data isolation for PII logs.
• Current traffic shape: bursty sessions, average request size ~800 tokens, peaks 4000 reqs/min across regions.
• Key constraints: SOC 2 compliance, internal KMS, and a procurement window that may close this quarter if capacity targets are met.

Given the security and latency goals we discussed, I recommended two serving paths:
1) Redwood Private (VPC) — customer-managed network with our private control plane; best when you need dedicated networking, KMS/HSM integrations, and audit logs.
2) Redwood Dedicated — reserved GPU pools we host; predictable throughput, lower ops for your infra team.

Next steps I propose:
1) I share a short one-pager that contrasts Private vs Dedicated for your use case (attached).
2) Your security/infra team completes the SOC2/technical checklist (I attached a starter spreadsheet).
3) If Private looks like the right path, we schedule a 30-min technical alignment with our infra engineer to scope networking/KMS needs.

Can you confirm who from your security team I should loop in? Also, is the procurement decision still on a Q4 timeline from your side?

Thanks — happy to adjust based on priorities.

Best,
Sergio Alvarez
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood-private-options-overview.pdf (summary), Aurora-SOC2-ask-checklist.xlsx (starter)
From: Olivia Tan <olivia.tan@auroraanalytics.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@auroraanalytics.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Oct 2026 10:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + suggested next steps (private hosting options)

Thanks, Sergio —

Appreciate the clear recap. Samir and I reviewed the one-pager and the checklist looks useful. A few questions from security/procurement that came up: 

• Can you share a redacted SOC 2 report or a SOC summary for customers?
• For Private, what does the standard onboarding timeline look like (networking + KMS hookup)?
• Ballpark monthly cost delta between Dedicated reserved capacity and Private deployment for our traffic profile — even a rough range helps our CFO.

Procurement is targeting late Q4 but it depends on costs and any integration effort. I can loop in our security lead if that helps; who should I add?

Thanks,
Olivia
Head of Product Operations
Aurora Analytics
olivia.tan@auroraanalytics.com

Subject: Re: Post-call recap + suggested next steps (private hosting options)

Hi Olivia —

Quick answers and resources: 

• SOC 2: We can share a redacted SOC 2 Type II summary; I've uploaded the redacted summary link to the Drive (link below). For procurement, we can also do an NDA-first exchange if you prefer.
• Onboarding timeline: Private (VPC) typical: 3–6 weeks for networking + KMS integration depending on calendar and your infra availability. Dedicated: 2–3 weeks if you accept our reserved-capacity config.
• Cost delta: For your traffic profile, rough estimate — Dedicated baseline: ~$40k–$60k/month; Private (VPC) including KMS and dedicated infra: ~$65k–$95k/month. We can refine with a scoping call.

Next suggested action: If Private is the direction, can we schedule a 30-minute technical sync the week of Oct 12th with our infra engineer (Marissa) + your security lead? I can also produce a short ops checklist for your procurement team.

Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2c3RedwoodPrivateOverview

I've attached the one-pager and SOC2 starter checklist to this thread.

Best,
Sergio

Subject: Quick follow-up — priority check on Private / Dedicated path

Hi Olivia —

Bumping this thread in case it slipped through — wanted to check whether Aurora has a sense of prioritization on the Private vs Dedicated decision. A couple quick options so we can plan resources: 

A) If Private is high priority this quarter — we can slot a technical sync with Marissa (infra) on Oct 15 or Oct 16 and fast-track the redacted SOC2 + procurement checklist.
B) If Priority is medium / still evaluating — we can provide a tighter cost model and a short hosted demo for your security team to review controls.
C) If it's deprioritized past Q4 — no problem, we can park the scoping work and touch base next quarter.

Would you be able to share your security lead's name / email so we can send the SOC2 NDA and schedule the sync if helpful? If easier, pick a time on my calendar: https://calendly.com/sergio-redwood/30

Thanks — quick thumbs on A/B/C is all I need to plan our next steps.

Best,
Sergio Alvarez
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
